title: PROCESIO Form Template config
description: Build a form from a list of controls. The builder clones a golden element per control type and overrides label/name/required/options/etc. Renders from elements (no encrypted code needed).

isPrivate.description: false = public (designer 'Make form public' = !isPrivate). NOT sufficient on its own: a form containing an approval control (or assignees/approvers) can ONLY be private — the platform disables the toggle regardless of this value.

theme.description: form-wide theme {cssVariable: value} overrides, e.g. {"--c-primary":"#0039e3","--p-form":"24px"}. Container elements also accept alignment vars in their per-control style: --fd/--jc/--ai-<section|list-item|column|step|tab|side-panel>

dark.description: enable dark mode: adds a {light,dark} ModeProperties palette (the 16-var DARK_PALETTE) to the Colors theme group, the shape the form runtime reads

themeDark.description: dark-palette {cssVariable: value} overrides on top of the 16-var DARK_PALETTE default (implies dark)

css.description: form-level CSS (designer 'Switch to code' CSS tab); AES-encrypted into Data.code

javascript.description: form-level JavaScript ('Switch to code' JS tab); AES-encrypted into Data.code

chainConfig.description: multi-form 'app' dashboard: {columns:[...]} composing several forms into one navigable application (Data.chainConfig)

events.description: control events: each {on: click|input|focus|blur|open|tabchange, do: map|process|js|form|datastore, ...}

type.description: control type: heading, paragraph, input, textarea, number-input, datetime-input, select, dropdown, radiobox, checkbox, button, divider, section, columns, column, image, file-upload, table, tabs, tab, ...

name.description: field/binding name (defaults to a slug of label). ALSO the query-param key for URL pre-fill: opening the public form at ...?<name>=<value> pre-fills this control (validated live 2026-07-22). Pick a stable, URL-safe name when you want to seed the control from a link.

options.description: for select/radiobox/dropdown: list of strings or {name,value} (static-list shortcut)

optionsSource.description: options data source: {type: json|static-list|url, value: <array|string|url>}. json -> sourceType JSON; url -> sourceType URL.

style.description: per-control style overrides {cssVariable: value}, e.g. {"--h-input":"50px"}. Only vars of the control's CSS group are valid (input/number/datetime/textarea/select use the Input group). For color vars (type css-variable-select) pass a theme color variable like "--c-neutral--50", NOT a hex.

configs.description: advanced: set any element config key by name

dataStoreId.description: datastore trigger: target data store id

filters.description: datastore trigger: row filters (not for ADD)
